component: ComfyUI Windows portable, Ollama Windows runtime, and bundled Qwen3 4B model
release_blockers: Inventory every file in each official Windows portable archive and identify bundled redistributable components.
Inventory embedded Python packages from dist-info METADATA, wheel metadata, and package license files.
Identify PyTorch, torchvision, torchaudio, CUDA/ROCm/XPU runtime libraries, and their separate license/notice obligations for each GPU variant.
Collect upstream license texts, copyright notices, attribution requirements, and source-offer/source-code obligations where applicable.
Review 7-Zip executable and source archive licensing for the exact selected release.
Check trademark, redistribution, export, and model-license issues separately from software package licenses.
Have the completed inventory and obligations reviewed before any public or customer distribution.
Inventory every dependency and redistribution notice in the exact Ollama Windows amd64 standalone runtime release.
Record the exact Qwen3 4B Ollama manifest digest and verify every referenced model blob SHA-256.
Review the Qwen3 model license and attribution for the exact model revision, and retain the upstream license and model notice.
Confirm the combined offline installer includes the correct runtime, model store, and third-party notices without relying on post-install network downloads.

Verify the pinned Stable Diffusion checkpoint SHA-256 against the downloaded bytes and perform a small-resolution CPU-only inference test on the target AMD Ryzen 7 4800U device before claiming image generation is ready.

Stable Diffusion 1.5 Open RAIL-M: implement an enforceable end-user agreement and affirmative acceptance for paragraph 5 / Attachment A restrictions, and package the complete license plus attribution notices before enabling checkpoint distribution.
